search_text: published ZDI-14-071 ZDI-CAN-1780 WellinTech KingScada AEserver.exe Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-04-10 CVE-2014-0787 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-0787 10.0 ['WellinTech'] ['KingScada'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of WellinTech KingScada. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the protocol parsing code contained in kxNetDispose.dll. The parent service is called AEserver.exe and listens on port 12401. The process performs arithmetic on an user-supplied value used to determine the size of a copy operation allowing a potential integer wrap to cause a stack buffer overflow. An unauthenticated attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the SYSTEM user. WellinTech has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
